q: The Chaitin-Kolmogorov notion of a random sequence is related to Lyapunov exponents by the observation that:
opts: Positive Lyapunov exponents imply Martin-Löf randomness of all orbits
The symbolic sequence generated by a uniformly hyperbolic system with positive entropy can be Martin-Löf random relative to the computable measure
Lyapunov exponents determine Kolmogorov complexity exactly
exp: For hyperbolic systems with positive entropy, the symbolic coding of a generic orbit is algorithmically random (relative to the natural invariant measure). This connects dynamical randomness to algorithmic randomness.
